title: HackerRank: Time Conversion (12h to 24h)
description: Given a time in 12-hour AM/PM format `s` (e.g. '07:05:45PM'), convert it to military (24-hour) time ('19:05:45'). Note: 12:00:00AM is 00:00:00 on a 24-hour clock, and 12:00:00PM is 12:00:00.
constraints:
Valid 12-hour time format hh:mm:ssAM or hh:mm:ssPM
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Handles boundary hours 12 AM (00) and 12 PM (12) with O(1) parsing.
